status.description: success only if every verification command was actually run and exited 0. needs_claude for architectural, security or destructive-scope ambiguity.

risk.description: high for production, credentials, auth, data mutation, network exposure, branch protection or broad refactors.

summary.description: What was implemented, in plain prose. No chain-of-thought, no file contents.

changed.description: One entry per changed target: 'path/to/File.java - what changed and why'.

verified.description: One entry per verification command actually executed, in the form '<command> => exit <code>'. Never list a command you did not run.

review.description: Result of your own self-review pass over your own diff.

findings.description: Real problems you found and could not fix, or deliberately left. Empty if none.

next.description: The single most useful next action for Claude, or 'none'.
